field_checks.summary: Primary XML/PDF tables 4 and 5 were independently checked against the final activity record set: 56 non-dash MIC/MBC cells are represented and 22 dash cells are excluded. However, the source-located time-kill surface is omitted from final activity/toxicity evidence: source xml:p:45 and Figure 5 report bactericidal/bacteriostatic time-kill results for P1/P2/P3 against K. pneumoniae 10031, while final activity records contain no time-kill/CFU endpoint or explicit exclusion.

Database-layer final preserves fallback boundary: authoritative linked article/assay/sequence/literature rows are all zero, source_verified count is zero, fallback machine rows remain candidate-only, and authoritative_dbaasp_ingest_ready is false. Primary peptide identities are source-supported in Table 3 with C-terminal amidation preserved, but database evidence remains non-authoritative rather than release-ready.

Same-name paper-final and packet-final JSON files are byte-identical, and packet-final mechanism_evidence.json is byte-identical to mechanism_ontology_record.json. But the current final materials_manifest in both mirrors is stale: it still reports analysis_queue_status=analysis_queued and a strict_boundary saying the packet is not source-reviewed until workers 4-6 pass, while packet_manifest, analysis_status, review_report, and the strict acceptance report assert analysis_source_reviewed_accepted/publication_grade true.

Mechanism classes are mostly conservative for MIC/biofilm/CD/SEM, but the final mechanism record is not publication-grade: it omits the qPCR virulence-gene expression source surface from xml:p:52/xml:fig:9, and it contains recursive artifact locators in mechanism support fields. These are source coverage and provenance failures, not merely gate-report issues.

Primary XML/PDF identity matches PMCID PMC12162962, PMID 40520369, DOI 10.3389/fmicb.2025.1569719, title, journal, and 2025 publication year. Table 3 supports Pantinin 1/2/3 sequences GILGKLWEGFKSIV-NH2, IFGAIWKGISSLL-NH2, and FLSTIWNGIKSLL-NH2; terminal amidation is not a residue. A recursive JSON scan found no current final object containing both plain sequence and sequence_length.

Activity table values use direct source units and approximate toxicity bars are marked ambiguous, but locator integrity fails in mechanism finals: source/supporting locator fields contain packet_analysis:activity_toxicity_evidence.worker2.json and database:dbaasp_machine_extracted_rows.jsonl instead of primary-source or row-level database locators.

Fallback release boundary is preserved: authoritative ingest is false and fallback rows remain candidate-only. Recursive authority boundary is not preserved because final mechanism source/support locator fields cite analysis/database artifact files as evidence locators.

The final review correctly preserves the caution that there are no authoritative linked database rows. Source spelling irregularities are present in the primary paper title/table labels, so raw source labels should remain separated from normalized labels where used.

The staged supplement Table_1.docx is readable and was inspected via DOCX text, archive members, converted images, and OCR/text surfaces. It contains Supplementary Material and LC-MS characterization Figures S1-S3 for Pantinin 1/2/3 plus publisher logos, with no additional MIC/MBC/toxicity table requiring layer-2 extraction.

HaCaT MTT toxicity/selectivity evidence from Figure 4 is represented as 18 toxicity records across P1/P2/P3 concentrations, with approximate graph-derived values marked ambiguous and source-located to XML/PDF figure surfaces. No source-local hemolysis or in vivo toxicity surface was found in the inspected XML/PDF/supplement.

blocking_findings.reason: Layer-2 final activity evidence omits a primary activity surface. The source states in xml:p:45 that kill-time monitoring against K. pneumoniae 10031 showed P1 eradication within 1 h at 4xMIC and 2xMIC, P2 bactericidal effects, and P3 bacteriostatic behavior; Figure 5/caption 10 contains the time-course CFU/mL plots. Final activity_toxicity_evidence.json has MIC/MBC, FICI, biofilm, and toxicity records but no time-kill/CFU endpoint record or source-located exclusion.
required_actions: Add source-located time-kill activity/phenotype records for P1, P2, and P3 against K. pneumoniae 10031, or add a source-located explicit exclusion explaining why row-level extraction is not scientifically supportable.
Preserve endpoint, treatment, concentration or MIC multiple, timepoint, target strain, raw value/unit or qualitative/no-unit rationale, exact-vs-approximate status, and source locators.
Do not invent exact CFU/mL values from Figure 5 unless they are digitized with approximate status and uncertainty.
Rebuild both paper and packet final activity mirrors and update review coverage/counts after repair.
acceptance_checks: A read-only script over papers/PMC12162962/final/activity_toxicity_evidence.json finds time-kill records or explicit exclusions whose source_locators include xml:p:45 and xml:fig:5 or xml:caption:10.

Every repaired time-kill object has endpoint, treatment, target_species, target_strain_or_isolate, assay_conditions, raw_value or explicit no-exact-value rationale, raw_unit or qualitative-unit rationale, normalization_status, and source_locator/source_locators.

blocking_findings.reason: The mechanism final is not source-reviewable at publication grade. It omits the source-local qPCR/virulence-factor mechanism surface: xml:p:52 reports suppression of galF, ompW, and fiu expression, and Figure 9/caption 14 locates the qPCR result. The same final also contains recursive locator values: mechanism_claims[1] and [3] use packet_analysis:activity_toxicity_evidence.worker2.json as supporting_source_locators, and excluded_or_nonpromoted_evidence[5].source_locator uses database:dbaasp_machine_extracted_rows.jsonl.
required_actions: Add a source-located qPCR/virulence-gene expression mechanism claim or explicit nonpromotion object with correct evidence class, entity scope, limitations, and source locators.

Replace packet_analysis and .json/.jsonl locator values in source/support locator fields with concrete primary-source locators or row-level database provenance; move artifact paths to checked_inputs or reviewed_surfaces metadata.
Preserve ontology boundaries among SEM direct morphology evidence, MIC/time-kill/biofilm phenotypes, CD/LPS biophysical evidence, qPCR gene-expression evidence, and database fallback rows.
acceptance_checks: A recursive scan of keys containing locator in paper and packet mechanism_ontology_record.json and packet mechanism_evidence.json returns zero source/support locator values containing packet_analysis:, .json, .jsonl, work/, extracted/, papers/, packets/, or pipeline_v2/.
A read-only query finds a qPCR/virulence-gene mechanism claim or explicit nonpromotion object with source_locators including xml:p:52 and xml:fig:9 or xml:caption:14.
Mechanism mirrors are byte-identical for paper-final mechanism_ontology_record.json, packet-final mechanism_ontology_record.json, and packet-final mechanism_evidence.json after repair.

blocking_findings.reason: The current final materials_manifest is stale in both final mirrors. It reports analysis_queue_status=analysis_queued and strict_boundary='packet handoff only; not source-reviewed until workers 4-6 and strict gates pass', while packet_manifest and analysis_status report analysis_source_reviewed_accepted and review_report/strict acceptance report claim publication_grade true. This contradicts the current final state and prevents reviewed_every_current_final_record from being publication-grade ready.
required_actions: Regenerate or reclassify final/materials_manifest.json so material and analysis statuses match current packet/review state, or remove it from the authoritative final record set with an explicit mirror policy.
Update strict_boundary wording so current final records do not contradict source-reviewed acceptance state.
Mirror the repaired material manifest to packet final and rerun final file-set/hash/count consistency checks.
acceptance_checks: No current final JSON contains stale strict_boundary text saying the paper is not source-reviewed after review_report claims publication_grade true.
All same-name paper-final and packet-final JSON files are byte-identical, and any packet-only alias such as mechanism_evidence.json is declared or byte-identical to its canonical mechanism final.

cautions.summary: No authoritative DBAASP/APD6/DRAMP linked rows are present for this paper; fallback machine rows are candidate-only and must remain excluded from RC2/portal/authoritative ingest.

The primary source itself uses irregular spellings/labels such as title 'Klebsiella pnemoniae', Table 1 'pneuomiae', and Table 4 'S. thyphimurium'; raw source labels should be preserved separately from any normalized species fields.
